scenario.topic: Decide on the signature cocktail for the rooftop bar opening

options.name: Citrus Sunset Spritz
options.upside: Bright and refreshing with a popular aperitif base.
options.concern: May not appeal to guests who prefer stronger cocktails.

options.name: Herbal Gin Fizz
options.upside: Herbaceous flavor complements summer evenings and pairs well with light fare.
options.concern: Longer preparation time could slow service during peak hours.

options.name: Spiced Pineapple Mule
options.upside: Tropical and slightly spicy, offering a unique twist on a classic mule.
options.concern: Spice level may not suit all palates.

options.name: Berry Lavender Collins
options.upside: Floral and fruity notes create a visually attractive and aromatic drink.
options.concern: Lavender flavor might be too subtle for some guests.

shared_context: The rooftop bar is opening next month and needs a signature cocktail that appeals to a diverse crowd. The drink should be visually appealing, easy to prepare by bartenders, and incorporate seasonal ingredients.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is the bar manager with a passion for crafting drinks that delight a broad audience.
personas.private_goal: Ensure the signature cocktail is easy to prepare and visually appealing to boost sales.

A.reason_for: Bright and refreshing with a popular aperitif base, easy to prepare in 45 seconds.

B.reason_for: Herbaceous flavor fits summer evenings and pairs well with food.
B.reason_against: Longer preparation time of 60 seconds could slow service.

C.reason_for: Unique tropical twist with moderate prep time.
C.reason_against: Spice level may not suit all palates.

D.reason_for: Visually attractive and aromatic with floral and fruity notes.
D.reason_against: Lavender flavor might be too subtle for some guests.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a bartender focused on speed and customer satisfaction during peak hours.
personas.private_goal: Choose a cocktail that can be prepared quickly without sacrificing taste.

A.reason_for: Preparation time is reasonable and the drink is refreshing.
A.reason_against: Lower alcohol content might not satisfy all customers.

B.reason_against: 60 seconds prep time is too long for busy shifts.

C.reason_for: Moderate prep time and a unique spicy tropical flavor that stands out.

D.reason_for: Nice visual appeal and aromatic qualities.
D.reason_against: Slightly longer prep time and subtle lavender might be overlooked.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a beverage consultant who values innovative flavors and seasonal ingredients.
personas.private_goal: Select a cocktail that highlights fresh herbs and offers a sophisticated taste.

A.reason_for: Popular aperitif base and refreshing taste.
A.reason_against: May be too light in alcohol for some guests.

B.reason_for: Herbaceous flavor with fresh basil complements summer and pairs well with food.

C.reason_for: Unique spicy tropical flavor and moderate prep time.
C.reason_against: Spice level might not appeal to all.

D.reason_for: Floral and fruity with good visual appeal.
D.reason_against: Lavender flavor might be too subtle.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a casual customer who enjoys floral and fruity drinks with moderate alcohol content.
personas.private_goal: Find a signature cocktail that is aromatic and visually inviting without being overpowering.

A.reason_for: Bright and refreshing with a popular base spirit.
A.reason_against: Might be too light for some.

B.reason_against: Long prep time and stronger alcohol content may be less appealing.

C.reason_for: Tropical and unique with moderate prep time.

D.reason_for: Floral and fruity notes create an aromatic and visually attractive drink.

personas.name: Nia
personas.background: Nia is a marketing specialist focused on drinks that photograph well and attract social media attention.
personas.private_goal: Promote a signature cocktail that is both visually stunning and trendy.

A.reason_against: Lower alcohol content might limit appeal.

D.reason_against: Lavender flavor might be too subtle.
